steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—education level, years of project experience, and contact hours—to confirm you meet the baseline. Killeen's defense, healthcare, and construction sectors actively employ PMP®-certified professionals; your background likely qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. All sessions are delivered online, so you can attend from home or work across the Killeen area. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® framework, exam domains, and real-world application—at your own pace, on your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your PMP® application directly to PMI. Include your education credentials, project-experience documentation, and Granite PM Academy's completion verification. Pay the exam fee to finalize your registration with the Project Management Institute.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A support—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and boost your confidence before exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential renews on a three-year cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and professional activities to stay current. Many Killeen employers—from Fort Cavazos contractors to healthcare systems—value active credential holders; maintaining your PMP® keeps you competitive.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
